# GitHub Actions maintenance

Follow the [repository rules](../AGENTS.md). [Build](../docs/build.md) owns commands, [CI controls](../docs/ci-free-tier.md) owns hosted scope/storage/signing guidance, [plan](../docs/plan.md) owns remaining work and [validation](../docs/validation.md) owns executed evidence. Verify current workflows/scripts before relying on historical receipts.

- Preserve manual dispatch, public-repository-only standard Ubuntu runners, full action commit pins, bounded jobs and automatic one-day artifact uploads. Only workflow 09 also runs daily at 03:23 UTC, deleting completed runs older than seven days; manual preview/clear remains available. Gradle uses the basic GitHub cache provider: default-branch runs may save caches; other branches remain read-only. Do not add paid runners/services or increase cache allowances. The owner's no-payment-method statement is recorded in CI guidance; workflow files do not independently verify account billing.
- Shared Android setup runs after checkout. Enforce policies on parsed workflows and referenced local composite actions; retain non-cancelling workflow concurrency, required visual evidence and scoped cleanup/security permissions. Changes to YAML parsing require the checksum-pinned CI Python dependency.
- Workflows 06/10 distribute default-branch debug APKs through shared android-build-N reservations and isolated debug-signing jobs. Workflow 11 uses the same registry for explicit production codes. Reservation jobs alone may add the shared non-cancelling aqaqeer-version-reservations concurrency group. Workflow 06 selects standard, demo or both; both uses independent serialized jobs with fail-fast off. Package through the shared local selector and scope each APK/diagnostic/summary to its selected flavor.
- Keep zero-padded display numbers and Checks/Build/Verify/Maintenance groups as suggested run order, not execution dependencies. Preserve workflow filenames when changing labels and update the canonical build table; GitHub-managed Dependabot runs are outside this numbering.
- Keep token permissions minimal and credentials out of logs/artifacts. Cleanup must use default-branch workflow/script guards and recheck repository/run ownership, completed status, age, attempt and update identity before deleting a run. The user authorized removing completed runs with their attempts, logs, summaries and all attached artifacts (including APKs); preserve active runs, repository files, Releases/assets and caches. Manual days=0 clears all eligible completed runs; manual preview defaults on. Do not execute cleanup merely because its workflow is configured.
- Keep emulator selections explicit and offline. Bind ADB to the owned ephemeral emulator and retain identity checks/capture cleanup. Hosted CI changes do not resume local builds, local Android tests/lint, physical-phone or live Telegram campaigns; follow current session authorization and the plan.
- Package through the wrapper and preserve normal checkout-local version reservation. Do not persist private signing keys or substitute a fresh signer for an existing installation. Keep all three debug publication modes with latest=false. New workflows 12–15 remain manual; raw history-scan findings never become public logs/artifacts. Unsigned release inspection must remain clearly distinct from signed distribution/update acceptance; the optional expected certificate is a declared manual workflow input.
- Use source-level workflow/policy/syntax/link checks within authorization. Report hosted execution, actual Android results and media quality separately from source or simulated-helper checks. Keep completed evidence and pending execution in their canonical records rather than adding status history here.
